description: Auto-action policy thresholds not agreed in time
trigger: No decision at the policy review
mitigation: Ship answer-only mode first; take cost of delay to the decision forum

description: Answer quality below threshold on long intake threads
trigger: Golden-set score below threshold two runs in a row
mitigation: Cap input size; chunk long threads; set a latency budget

description: Support not staffed for launch week
trigger: Roster not confirmed two weeks before launch
mitigation: Confirm roster at the next partner sync

description: Golden set does not reflect the real intake mix
trigger: Pilot misses not covered by any golden case
mitigation: Add a golden case for every pilot miss
effect_if_materializes: Evaluation passes but production quality lags

description: Launch answer-only mode without non-English intake support
trigger: Non-English share of intake above agreed limit
mitigation: Detect language and escalate to a human; permanent fix in the next release
effect_if_materializes: Some requests go straight to humans
notes: Accepted risk. Expiry is the resolve_by date.
